QuestInfo.name: Skeletons in Hazard's Closet
QuestInfo.0: Hazard had more dirty laundry than suspected. #bGen#k will want to hear about this.
QuestInfo.1: Gen hastily hands you a message from HQ, then becomes engrossed in Hazard's account.\r\nAnd #bConey#k seems to have a chip on his shoulder about something.
QuestInfo.2: Guess he doesn't like being outshined.

0.msg: Ah, you have that smug I-just-completed-my-mission look. Show me what you got.\r\n

2.msg: Well, well. It looks like Mr. Hazard was a busy man. I think you've earned some of his old business.\r\n

3.msg: Ah, but first, I have good news. And an update from headquarters about the fate of our dear Mr. Hazard.\r\n

4.msg: You've impressed some of the head honchos. Expect bigger missions from now on. Of course, they'll be more dangerous, too...\r\n

5.msg: I don't care what they think about me! But... bigger missions, you say?\r\n

6.msg: Yeah, yeah, you're so cool. Anyway, you're taking over one of Hazard's accounts, so take a break.\r\n

yes.0: The Papyrus Brothers will fill you in on the details. And check in with #bConey#k while you're at it.\r\n

1.0: That business with the secret account went well, I see. And... I heard good news from headquarters about the Mr. Hazard matter...\r\n

0.msg: I'm impressed. HQ usually doesn't pay attention to rookies. Someday, they'll talk about me the same way... Maybe...\r\n

1.msg: I guess I need to learn how to fight, first. The Papyrus Brothers said they'd teach me a move or two...\r\n

2.msg: Trying to beat me, are you? Fine. As long as you do what I say, I don't care. You're my number one lackey, after all.\r\n

3.msg: Oh, you big bully... I think the P-Papyrus Brothers are calling you!\r\n

4.msg: Don't be so scared all the time. I'll buy you a nice, chewy corn dog sometime, so relax.\r\n

default.0: The Papyrus Brothers will fill you in on the details. And check in with #bConey#k while you're at it.\r\n
